## Checklist

- [ ] I have signed (or will sign when prompted) the [Contributor License Agreement](../CLA.md)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] The version is bumped in **both** `manifest.json` and `package.json` (not needed for README-only changes)
- [ ] The plugin's README says what it does, its configuration, and where its data comes from, including the provider's terms
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, tokens or personal data in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Every network call the plugin makes is listed in its README
- [ ] I wrote this code or have the right to contribute it under AGPL-3.0-or-later
- [ ] No commit credits an AI assistant as author or co-author (mention one here instead, if you used one)
